title: Senior Raft Guide & Safety Kayaker / Kayak leiðbeinandi
description: Arctic Rafting is looking for a Senior Raft Guide and Safety Kayaker / Kayak Instructor for the upcoming summer season of 2027. Our season is May – September, with our high season in the summer time; June – August. There are some operations and preparations to do also before and after, in April and October. In particular, we are looking for someone to come in March, to repair equipment and do admin office work for the river operation, to prepare for the summer. This position will extend to be all year round, working part time over the winter months and taking a long leave (1-3 months). Arctic Rafting has a base camp on the well known tourist circuit of “The Golden Circle” in the southern part of Iceland, in just over an hour drive from Reykjavík capital city. Our operations include family friendly rafting trips on the mighty Hvítá River (class II-III), which is the third longest river in Iceland, originating from Langjökull Glacier. Our base camp has other amenities like a bar, restaurant, sauna and hot tubs, so clients can wind down after an action-packed adventure on the river.The qualities we are looking for is experience with good customer service, and good team work skills. Any added language skills are appreciated, operational skills for safe and high quality river trips, repairing skills for river rafting gear and other equipment, and skills for cooking, cleaning, photography, marketing/office, mechanics and general handy man skills. Job description and responsibilities of a Senior Raft Guide:* Operate safe and entertaining river tours for clients (rafting or kayaking)* Be a team leader and trip lead a group of guides in rafting trips of the size of 100+ clients* Kitchen worker and general work in the restaurant and bar serving clients* Work around the property (repair gear, cleaning, laundry, gardening and handy man jobs)Requirements:* Current WRT (Whitewater Rescue Technician) or similar* Current IRF (International Rafting Federation) certification or similar* Up to date Advanced First Aid training* Minimum 5 seasons of raft guide experience* Good English skills to communicate with clientsExtras, good to have, but not a requirement:* A big bus license to drive the river shuttle (45 seater)* Kitchen and bar experience* Photography skills* Sales / marketing skillsWork arrangements:* We generally have one morning trip and one afternoon trip every day; you either do two trips per day, or one trip and then base work for the rest of the day (cooking, cleaning, repair gear, etc.)* The work days can be anything from 4-12 hours per day, but the normality is generally 8-9 hours* A full time job means 160-170 hours per month, and as the hours vary, the pay is by hourly rates* Normally you would get 2 days off per week, but this can vary to 1-3 days off weeklyHousing and food:* Living arrangements is at an old farm in the countryside 1,5 hour from Reykjavík city, next to the river rafting base / restaurant* Everyone gets their own private room, including shared facilities (bathroom with shower)* We do daily communal dinners and everyone is expected to partake in the cooking and cleaning at the end of the day* We supply breakfast, lunch and dinner; while you are at the raft base for work Rates:* Depending on your skill level and experience the pay would be around 2.500 – 2.900isk per hour* In addition to this we offer free housing and food for your stay during your work periodPlease note that in Iceland we pay around 40% tax, and other fees will be deducted too (union, pension fund etc.)Benefits:* Some great times living in the countryside, being a raft guide for an Icelandic summer season* Private room with shared facilities (bathroom with shower)* Use of base facilities (staff kitchen, hot pots and sauna)* Occasional use of communal work car; we strongly recommend having a valid driver’s license, as public transport in Iceland is quite horrid when you live at an old farm in the middle of nowhere.About the Company:This is one of the oldest adventure activities to do in Iceland, but the first river rafting trip with clients was made here in 1985. Around 1990 they started renovations at the old barn and farm house to make the raft base into what it is today; changing rooms, showers, sauna, hot pots, restaurant, bar and guide facilities; for around 10-12 staff members to live there for the summer season. Our clients are mostly from Iceland, Europe and USA, so the minimal language requirements are good English skills. Owned by a local raft guide and kayaker, and more details can be found on our website: www.arcticrafting.com This video sums up what a normal day in the summer looks like – https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6OXFlZTrEzQTo apply; please send a CV and cover letter to drumbo@arcticrafting.is before 1st of December 2026Best regards,The Arctic Rafting teamdrumbo@arcticrafting.iswww.arcticrafting.is / www.arcticrafting.comArctic Rafting leitar að reyndum flúðasiglingaleiðsögumanni (Senior Raft Guide) og öryggiskajakræðara/kajakkennara (Safety Kayaker / Kayak Instructor) fyrir komandi sumartímabil árið 2027.Starfstímabilið okkar er frá maí til september, en háannatíminn er yfir sumarmánuðina, júní til ágúst. Einnig þarf að sinna ýmsum undirbúnings- og rekstrarverkefnum fyrir og eftir tímabilið, í apríl og október.Við leitum sérstaklega að einstaklingi sem getur hafið störf í mars til að sinna viðgerðum á búnaði og skrifstofu- og stjórnsýsluverkefnum tengdum flúðasiglingarekstrinum, til undirbúnings fyrir sumarið.Starfið mun þróast yfir í heilsársstarf, þar sem unnið verður í hlutastarfi yfir vetrarmánuðina og möguleiki verður á lengra leyfi, í 1–3 mánuði.StarfsumhverfiðArctic Rafting er með bækistöð við hina þekktu ferðamannaleið Gullna hringinn á Suðurlandi, í rúmlega klukkustundar akstursfjarlægð frá Reykjavík.Starfsemin felur meðal annars í sér fjölskylduvænar flúðasiglingaferðir á hinni mikilfenglegu Hvítá (erfiðleikaflokkur II–III). Hvítá er þriðja lengsta á Íslands og á upptök sín við Langjökul.Á bækistöðinni er einnig bar, veitingastaður, gufubað og heitir pottar þar sem gestir geta slakað á eftir ævintýralega ferð niður ána.Eiginleikar sem við leitum aðVið leitum að einstaklingi sem hefur reynslu af góðri þjónustu við viðskiptavini og býr yfir góðri hæfni í teymisvinnu.Önnur tungumálakunnátta er kostur, sem og færni í að skipuleggja og framkvæma öruggar og vandaðar flúðasiglingaferðir.Einnig er kostur að hafa reynslu af viðgerðum á flúðasiglingabúnaði og öðrum tækjum, matreiðslu, þrifum, ljósmyndun, markaðssetningu, skrifstofustörfum, vélaviðgerðum og almennum viðhaldsverkefnum.Starfslýsing og ábyrgð yfirleiðsögumannsStjórna öruggum og skemmtilegum flúðasiglinga- og kajakferðum fyrir viðskiptavini.Vera leiðtogi teymis og stýra hópi leiðsögumanna í flúðasiglingaferðum með yfir 100 þátttakendum.Vinna í eldhúsi og sinna almennum störfum á veitingastað og bar, þar á meðal þjónustu við gesti.Sinna ýmsum verkefnum á svæðinu, svo sem viðgerðum á búnaði, þrifum, þvotti, garðvinnu og almennu viðhaldi.HæfniskröfurGilt WRT-skírteini (Whitewater Rescue Technician – sérhæfð björgun í straumvatni) eða sambærileg réttindi.Gild IRF-réttindi (International Rafting Federation – Alþjóðasamband flúðasiglinga) eða sambærileg réttindi.Gild og uppfærð réttindi í ítarlegri skyndihjálp (Advanced First Aid).Að lágmarki fimm tímabils reynsla sem flúðasiglingaleiðsögumaður.Góð enskukunnátta til að eiga samskipti við viðskiptavini.Viðbótarhæfni sem er kostur en ekki skilyrðiÖkuréttindi til að aka stórri rútu (45 farþega) sem notuð er til að flytja gesti til og frá ánni.Reynsla af eldhús- og barstörfum.Hæfni í ljósmyndun.Reynsla af sölu- og markaðsmálum.Vinnutími og starfskjörYfirleitt eru farnar tvær flúðasiglingaferðir á dag, ein að morgni og önnur síðdegis.Starfsmaður fer annaðhvort í tvær ferðir á dag eða eina ferð og sinnir síðan öðrum verkefnum á bækistöðinni, svo sem matreiðslu, þrifum eða viðgerðum á búnaði.Vinnudagar geta verið allt frá 4 upp í 12 klukkustundir, en algengast er að þeir séu um 8–9 klukkustundir.Fullt starf miðast við 160–170 vinnustundir á mánuði. Þar sem vinnustundir eru breytilegar eru laun greidd samkvæmt tímakaupi.Yfirleitt eru tveir frídagar í viku, en þeir geta verið frá einum upp í þrjá eftir aðstæðum.Húsnæði og fæðiStarfsfólk býr á gömlum sveitabæ í um 1,5 klukkustundar akstursfjarlægð frá Reykjavík, við hliðina á flúðasiglingabækistöðinni og veitingastaðnum.Allir starfsmenn fá sérherbergi en deila sameiginlegri aðstöðu, þar á meðal baðherbergi með sturtu.Sameiginlegur kvöldverður er á hverjum degi og ætlast er til að allir taki þátt í matreiðslu og frágangi í lok dags.Boðið er upp á morgunmat, hádegismat og kvöldmat á meðan starfsfólk er við vinnu á bækistöðinni.LaunTímakaup fer eftir hæfni og reynslu viðkomandi og er á bilinu 2.500–2.900 krónur á klukkustund.Auk launa er boðið upp á ókeypis húsnæði og fæði meðan á starfstímabilinu stendur.Athugið að á Íslandi geta skattar numið um 40% af launum og að önnur gjöld eru einnig dregin frá, svo sem stéttarfélagsgjöld og lífeyrissjóðsiðgjöld.FríðindiEinstakt tækifæri til að upplifa íslenskt sumar í sveitinni og starfa við flúðasiglingar.Sérherbergi með sameiginlegri baðaðstöðu.Aðgangur að aðstöðu á bækistöðinni, þar á meðal starfsmannaeldhúsi, heitum pottum og gufubaði.Stundum er hægt að nýta sameiginlegan starfsmannabíl.Við mælum eindregið með því að umsækjendur hafi gilt ökuskírteini, þar sem almenningssamgöngur á Íslandi eru afar takmarkaðar þegar búið er á gömlum sveitabæ úti í sveit.Um fyrirtækiðFlúðasiglingar eru ein elsta skipulagða ævintýraafþreying sem boðið hefur verið upp á á Íslandi. Fyrsta flúðasiglingaferðin með viðskiptavini á þessu svæði var farin árið 1985.Um 1990 hófst endurnýjun á gamla fjósinu og íbúðarhúsinu á bænum með það að markmiði að útbúa þá aðstöðu sem þar er í dag.Þar er nú að finna búningsklefa, sturtur, gufubað, heita potta, veitingastað, bar og aðstöðu fyrir leiðsögumenn. Á sumrin er aðstaða fyrir um 10–12 starfsmenn til að búa á staðnum.Viðskiptavinir okkar koma að mestu leyti frá Íslandi, Evrópu og Bandaríkjunum og því er góð enskukunnátta lágmarkskrafa.Fyrirtækið er í eigu flúðasiglingaleiðsögumanns og kajakræðara úr heimabyggð.Nánari upplýsingar um fyrirtækið má finna á vefsíðunni:www.arcticrafting.comMyndband sem sýnir dæmigerðan sumardag hjá Arctic Rafting:https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6OXFlZTrEzQUmsóknir:Áhugasamir eru beðnir um að senda ferilskrá og kynningarbréf á netfangið:drumbo@arcticrafting.isUmsóknarfrestur er til 1. desember 2026.Með bestu kveðju,Starfsfólk Arctic Raftingdrumbo@arcticrafting.iswww.arcticrafting.is / www.arcticrafting.com

title: Information Security Officer (Junior)
description: JBT Marel is seeking an Information security officer (Junior).Purpose:The Information Security Officer is part of the Information Security department within JBT Marel. The Information Security department is responsible for both Risk Management and Security Operations. The Information Security Officer supports the implementation and continuous improvement of JBT Marel’s security framework across the business. The role acts as a security liaison between business, technology and security teams and provides practical, risk-aligned guidance within assigned areas of responsibility.It is your mission to help identify, assess and document security risks across information, processes, projects and technologies, and to support the mitigation of those risks. You know how to collaborate with stakeholders, communicate clearly, and balance security requirements with business value and usability. The Information Security Officer closely cooperates with Cyber Security Specialists and other Information Security colleagues in audits, change management, incident coordination, awareness activities, policy updates and continuous improvement initiatives. Reports to:Chief Information Security Officer. Key areas of accountability: Risk management and advisory:Identify, assess and document security risks across information processes, projects and technologies within assigned areas of responsibility.Provide constructive security advisory for inquiries related to areas of responsibility, applying established guidelines and escalating complex topics where needed.Collaborate with business stakeholders to provide clear guidance and support the development of pragmatic, risk-aligned solutions.Support mitigation planning by providing input on security risks, controls and improvement actions.Policy management:Write and update security policies, standards and procedures for assigned areas of responsibility.Contribute to the implementation and continuous improvement of JBT Marel’s security policies, standards and procedures.Identify gaps in policies, standards and guidelines and propose improvements to reduce security risks. Security awareness:Promote security awareness by delivering training and championing Information Security objectives.Assess current security awareness maturity in assigned areas and use insights to drive targeted improvements and clear communication.Support the adoption of the right security behavior based on JBT Marel’s policies, standards and guidelines. Reporting, audits and operations:Report on security posture and incidents within assigned areas of responsibility.Participate in technical and non-technical audits, change management processes and incident coordination activities.Apply established guidelines to analyze and resolve routine security issues.Identify opportunities for control enhancement and process improvement in assigned areas of responsibility.Support continuous improvement of the organization’s security posture and monitor advancements in Information Security best practices.Team contribution:Operate with moderate supervision and seek guidance where needed.Support onboarding or training of new team members when requested.Provide input to employee performance evaluations as needed.Competencies and Skills:     Relating and networkingPresenting and communicating informationWriting and reportingAnalytical thinkingCooperativePro-activeConceptual/forward thinkingThoroughnessStress managementPragmatic and risk-based mindsetProficient English writing and speakingLevel of Knowledge and Experience:Bachelor level in information management and auditing, IT/information security, computer sciences, or a suitable combination of formal education and experience.1 - 3 years of experience in information security, risk management, IT audit, technology governance or a related field.Basic understanding of risk management, security policy management, security awareness, incident coordination and control improvement.Knowledge of international security standards or frameworks, such as ISO 27001, IEC 62443, OWASP, CIS Controls, NIST or ISF Standard of Good Practice, is desired.Preferred: experience in working in an international/ global organization.Preferred: knowledge of the manufacturing industry and business model/processes.Why Join JBT Marel?Joining JBT Marel means becoming part of a global leader in food processing technology that is helping feed the world more sustainably. You'll collaborate with talented colleagues across multiple countries, work on strategic global initiatives, and have opportunities to develop your career in an innovative, purpose-driven organization committed to continuous improvement, customer success, and operational excellence. Interested?📧 Apply by clicking the link to access the vacancy on JBT Marel´s website: https://jbtm.wd108.myworkdayjobs.com/JBT_Marel_Career_Site/job/IS---Gardabaer/Information-Security-Officer--Junior-_25689.🌐 Learn more about us at: JBTMarel.com🔗 Follow us on LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/jbtmarel/Last application date is November 17, 2026. Join us - and help shape the future of maintenance excellence at JBT Marel.Use of Technology in Our Hiring ProcessJBT Marel uses technology-assisted tools, including artificial intelligence (AI), to support the review of applications.These tools help our recruiting teams identify skills and experience relevant to the role based on job-related criteria.All applications are reviewed by people, and AI is not used to make hiring decisions independently. We are committed to fair, consistent and inclusive hiring practices globally.

title: HEAD CHEF AT A MICHELIN GUIDE-RECOMMENDED RESTAURANT IN REYKJAVÍK
description: HEAD CHEF AT A MICHELIN GUIDE-RECOMMENDED RESTAURANT IN REYKJAVÍKAre you ready to make your mark on one of Iceland’s most exciting culinary destinations?We are seeking a creative and ambitious Head Chef for a well-established fine dining restaurant in Reykjavík. Selected by the MICHELIN Guide, the restaurant offers contemporary Icelandic cuisine with strong roots in the country’s culinary heritage.This is a rare opportunity to lead a dedicated kitchen team, develop your own culinary direction and work with some of the Nordic region’s most distinctive ingredients.ABOUT THE RESTAURANTThe restaurant serves modern Icelandic cuisine, with seasonality, sustainability and local ingredients at its heart. The menus evolve with the seasons, showcasing the best Iceland has to offer—from fish, shellfish and lamb to wild herbs, seaweed and produce from local suppliers.The restaurant has recently moved to new premises with a larger, upgraded kitchen. The incoming Head Chef will have considerable creative freedom to develop the menus and help shape the restaurant’s future culinary direction.THE ROLEAs Head Chef, you will have overall responsibility for the kitchen’s culinary direction and operations. You will lead the team in its daily work, ensuring consistently exceptional standards throughout every service.Your responsibilities will include:    Leading, developing and motivating the kitchen team    Creating seasonal menus    Maintaining quality and consistency throughout every service    Establishing clear planning, structure and efficient kitchen workflows    Working closely with local, sustainably sourced ingredients    Further developing the restaurant’s identity and culinary direction    Creating a professional, safe and inclusive kitchen cultureWHO WE ARE LOOKING FORWe are looking for a creative, ambitious chef who is confident in a professional kitchen. You have a strong fine dining background and understand the precision, quality and attention to the overall guest experience expected at MICHELIN Guide level.You may already be working as a Head Chef, or you may be an outstanding Sous Chef ready to take the next step into a leadership role.We believe you bring:    Substantial experience in fine dining or another high-level culinary environment    Experience in menu development and working with seasonal ingredients    A clear, hands-on leadership style    The ability to bring structure, quality and a positive working atmosphere to the kitchen    A genuine interest in sustainability and local ingredients    The ability to balance creativity with quality, financial discipline and reliable operations    Strong communication skills in an international working environmentExperience at a Michelin restaurant or an equivalent culinary level is an advantage, but potential, leadership and ambition can be equally important.A KITCHEN WITH A STRONG TRADITION OF WOMEN IN GASTRONOMYFor the past ten years, the restaurant’s kitchen has been staffed by an all-female team. The restaurant is deeply committed to supporting women in gastronomy and creating opportunities for female chefs to develop into leaders.We want to continue building a workplace where women can grow, make an impact and take on culinary leadership roles. We welcome qualified applicants of all genders and select candidates based on their skills, leadership, motivation and potential.WHAT’S ON OFFER    A key leadership role at a restaurant recommended by the MICHELIN Guide    Considerable creative freedom to shape the menus and culinary direction    A larger, recently upgraded restaurant kitchen    Access to unique Icelandic ingredients and local producers    The opportunity to lead and develop an ambitious kitchen team    An international career opportunity in Reykjavík    Accommodation options, discussed individually    Salary, start date and other terms by agreementABOUT REYKJAVÍKReykjavík offers a rare combination of urban creativity, a vibrant restaurant scene and spectacular natural surroundings. The sea, mountains, hot springs and some of the Nordic region’s most exciting ingredients are all close at hand.For the right person, this is more than a new job. It is an opportunity to create something of your own while discovering a new country, a new food culture and a new way of life.HOW TO APPLYThe recruitment process is managed by Wildcard Untap, which helps hospitality businesses find skilled specialists and leaders through proactive search, personal dialogue and professional judgement.Please send your CV and a brief introduction outlining your experience, leadership approach and culinary philosophy to:jobb@wildcarduntap.comPlease use the subject line: “Head Chef – Reykjavík”Applications will be reviewed and interviews held on an ongoing basis. All applications will be treated confidentially.

description: Venue Operations and Client Support Co-OrdinatorAgTechUCD Innovation Centre, UCD Lyons FarmPosition type    Full-time Fixed Term for 24 monthsLocation    AgTechUCD Innovation Centre, UCD Lyons Research Farm, Celbridge, Co KildareReports to    Director of Innovation UCDSalary    €60,000 per year Hours    37 hours Full-time, with occasional evening and weekend eventsAbout AgTechUCDAgTechUCD is University College Dublin’s innovation centre for early-stage start-ups and SMEs working in agri, agtech, agrifood and veterinary sectors. Part of NovaUCD, it builds on NovaUCD’s track record of supporting high-tech start-ups. It is a collaboration between UCD and a network of industry, investor and research partners.AgTechUCD is a collaboration between NovaUCD, Kildare County Council, and Kildare LEO and is funded by the Regional Enterprise Development Fund. It also includes support from agri-companies such as; Devenish, Dairymaster, and Glanbia; investors such as; The Yield Lab, and Atlantic Bridge, along with leading AgTech researchers and innovators at UCD, Teagasc and Wageningen University and Research, Netherlands.  The AgTech Innovation Centre is based at UCD Lyons Farm, the University’s research and teaching farm. The building (about 890 sq.m.) offers flexible lab spaces, meeting rooms, offices and an exhibition space, and sits alongside the UCD Bimeda Herd Health Hub. It is home to a growing community of resident companies and is also available as a venue for events, workshops and industry gatherings.The RoleWe are looking for an energetic, organised and practical Venue Operations and Client Support Co-Ordinator to run the building day to day and to grow its profile as a venue for events and home for AgTech Start Up companies.This is primarily an operations role, with a meaningful commercial side. description: As a Civil Engineer Intern, you will support multidisciplinary teams delivering water and wastewater projects in office and site environments while building practical skills across project delivery, quality, safety and sustainability. title: Supervisor – Community Employment (CE)
description: The CE Sponsoring Organisation (Ringsend & District Response to Drugs) is responsible for the terms and conditions of employment of Supervisors as outlined in the CE Procedures Manual. Ensure the security of cash/equipment on scheme as directed by the Project Management Committee.  • Install and manage effective time keeping record system for participants on scheme.  • Liaise with the local DEASP Office as required.  Training & Development Provision  • Carry out an identification of learner needs with each participant on the scheme as part of the Individual Learner Plan process.  • Identify needs and source and co-ordinate cost effective training/development opportunities in line with DEASP procurement guidelines.  • Prepare an Individual Learning Plan for each Participant for submission to DEASP in accordance with CE procedures.  • Ensure access to recognised qualifications for participants, with a focus on the achievement of relevant qualifications including Major Awards on the National Framework of Qualifications (NFQ) or industry related equivalent. Plan and procure relevant training opportunities which have been approved by DEASP. Maintain and update training records for each participant on the project as part of their Individual Learner Plans. Monitor and review training inputs with the participants. Plan and organise work placements — internal and external as required.  • Report on ILP developments to the Project Management Committee.  www.rdrdthespellmancentre.ie Human Resources  • Co-ordinate the recruitment of CE applicants per the CE Recruitment and Referral Process issued by DEASP.  • Plan and co-ordinate the approved work schedules and ensure contracts of employment are in place for all participants.  • Communicate effectively with all participants on the scheme using team meetings and individual formal and informal 'one-to-one' meetings.  • Develop a mutual understanding with participants in relation to their needs for re-entry to work where the participant had been long-term unemployed and needs to develop a clear progression path. •  Implement job search activities with participants.  • Deal with all disciplinary matters in relation to participants in accordance with DEASP CE procedures. •  Liaise with employers to promote progression to work and work with other support organisations as needed.  • Develop an exit plan with each participant.  • Follow-up and report on participants for up to 4 months on exit from CE.  • Engage in training and development as detailed in Procedures Manual.  • Report to the Project Management Committee as required.  Scheme Management  • Provide a safe and healthy environment for participants - both in terms of facilities and work practices. • Ensure work experience placements on scheme are in line with CE application. Supervise, schedule and manage participants.  • Fully participate in training and development opportunities provided by the Sponsor and by DEASP as required for the post.  • Carry out any other function relevant to the position of Supervisor (Community Employment) as indicated by the Project Management Committee.  Financial Monitoring and Programme and Training Monitoring  • Ensure the CE scheme is compliant with financial, programme and training monitoring requirements as detailed in the CE Operating Procedures.  Progression of CE Participants  • Exit Planning  • Intensive Job Search activities as part of exit planning  • Engagement with Local Employer • Database of Employers  PERSONAL SPECIFICATION  Essential  • Knowledge of post Have a solid understanding of the role of the Community Employment Supervisor as it pertains to project management and programme delivery to long-term unemployed and vulnerable adults. Display responsibility, commitment and motivation to implement the objectives of the Community Employment Programme.  www.rdrdthespellmancentre.ie • Work Experience  Previous supervisory and people management experience relevant to post (3 years minimum). - Previous experience in Administration, Project Management and/or Training or other relevant positions.  • Interpersonal Skills  Effective communication skills. Competent report writing skills. Experience of working with vulnerable individuals and jobseekers. - Capable of directing, motivating, coaching and mentoring jobseekers. Ability to work under the direction of the Sponsoring Organisation for the effective implementation of the CE Programme in line with the CE Operational Procedures.  • Qualifications  Major Award at 3rd Level (NFQ Level 6 or higher) in Business/Financial Administration, Training, Human Resources, Project Management or related disciplines. ICT skills essential (e.g. MS Office) and certification in Addiction Studies ideal. Salary & Benefits • Salary: Aligned with DSP CE Supervisor Scale, commencing at Point 1. Although in the case of a person already employed as a CE supervisor being the successful candidate, they would receive their current rate of pay. • 39 hours per week standard full-time role. • Access to staff support, CISM (Critical Incident Stress Management), and Employee Assistance services. Apply by sending CV to the manager at catherine.meleady@rdrd.ie or by post to the Manager, 17 Irishtown Road, Dublin D04PW10.  Closing date for applications is 5pm on Tuesday 17th of November.

title: Healthcare Assistant - Clare
description: Location:Clare, Co ClareAbout the Role:Irish HomeCare is seeking qualified and experienced Healthcare Assistants to join our growing team in Clare.  Successful candidates will be responsible for providing home care services to our clients in the local community.Key Responsibilities:    Provide personal, non-medical care and assistance to clients in their own homes    Assist with clients’ physical, nutritional and social needs as laid out in their Care Plan.    These duties may include providing personal care (e.g., washing, dressing, assisting with continence care), mobilising, assistance with feeding, meal preparation, light housekeeping, etc. Requirements:    A major award in Health or Social Care or equivalent (Qualified to Level 5 on the QQI Framework)    Previous care or healthcare experience    A general understanding of geriatric health and mobility issues    Strong verbal communication skills and good command of spoken and written English    A full Irish (or Irish recognised) Driving Licence and access to a vehicle is essentialHours of Work:    39 hours per week     Must be available to work various shifts, including mornings, afternoons and evenings (including weekends and bank holidays)Salary:    €32,691 per annumBenefits:        Refer a Friend scheme    Christmas BonusToPlease submit your application to jobs@irishhomecare.ie by 5pm on 10th Dec 2026

title: Chef de Partie
description: Employer: The Inn on Hibernian Way Limited T/A Lemon and DukeLocation: Unit 2, Royal Hibernian Way, Dawson Street, Dublin 2, D02 YK71, Ireland.Position: Chef de PartieNumber of Vacancies: 1The Inn on Hibernian Way Limited, trading as Lemon and Duke, is seeking a Chef de Partie to join its kitchen team.Main Duties and Responsibilities•    Prepare, season and cook a variety of dishes in accordance with established recipes, menus and quality standards.•    Manage and oversee an assigned section of the kitchen, ensuring the efficient preparation and presentation of food.•    Assist with menu planning, food preparation and the development of new dishes.•    Monitor food quality, portion control and presentation to maintain consistent standards.•    Supervise, organise and provide guidance to junior kitchen staff.•    Ensure compliance with food hygiene, health and safety regulations, including HACCP procedures.•    Coordinate daily kitchen activities, including food preparation, cleaning and the proper maintenance of kitchen equipment and utensils.•    Monitor stock levels, assist with inventory management and minimise food waste.•    Work collaboratively with the Head Chef and other kitchen staff to ensure efficient kitchen operations.Requirements•    Minimum of 2 years of relevant professional experience as a Chef de Partie or in a similar professional kitchen role.•    Strong knowledge of food preparation, cooking techniques and kitchen operations.•    Good understanding of food hygiene and HACCP standards.•    Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced kitchen environment.•    Strong organisational, communication and teamwork skills.Employment DetailsContract Type: 24-month fixed-term contract, full-timeWorking Hours: 39 hours per weekAnnual Salary: €36,605 grossHourly Rate: Approximately €18.05How to ApplyInterested candidates should send their CV to colm@lemonandduke.ie.

title: Support Care Worker
description: Job Title: Support Care WorkerEmployer: Depaul IrelandLocation: 18, Nicholas Street, Christchurch, Dublin 8 , D08 VCP7 Start Date: 01/02/2027Salary: 32691 - 39000Working Hours: 35 Hours per weekNo. of Positions: 5Job Description:In conjunction with residents and rest of the team to ensure that the house is kept to a good standard of tidiness, cleanliness and hygiene including communal areas and bathrooms. Encouraging service users to take responsibility for maintaining their own environment and supporting them with laundry and cleaning tasks where appropriate.  To encourage and support service users to develop skills in managing their daily living.  In conjunction with project team, to assist residents with personal monies, service charge payments, etc. where necessary.  Carry out project administration tasks such as upkeep of petty cash, project statistics, invoices, record keeping, Service User’s files, OTIS, IR and AR completion etc.  To ensure that Health and Safety standards are met within the project in accordance with Depaul’s Health and Safety policy and the projects Safety Statement.  To undertake assigned duties regarding the overall health and safety and security of the service and to use security systems put in place. The above list is not exhaustive; additional areas of responsibility may be added over time and flexibility to cover for other staff roles is required from time to time. Experience of lone working or off-site working an advantage An understanding of enduring mental health issues and the impact it has on the individual. Good working knowledge of risk assessment processes and systems (i.e. S/U Risk assessment, Lone Working, Activity Risk Assessments) Be able to work as part of a team understanding the importance of team communication Have an understanding of Health and Safety and the health and safety requirements within a residential setting working with homeless people. Have a knowledge and understanding of the vision, mission and values of Depaul.

title: Floating Night Support Worker
description: Job Title: Floating Night Support WorkerEmployer: Depaul IrelandLocation: 18, Nicholas Street, Christchurch, Dublin 8 , D08 VCP7 Start Date: 1/02/2027Salary: 32691 - 39000Working Hours: 35 Hours per weekNo. of Positions: 5Job Description: To work with all service users to win their trust and respect and to deal with difficult or problematic situations in a sensitive manner. In conjunction with residents and ancillary team, to ensure that the house is kept to a good standard of tidiness, cleanliness and hygiene including communal areas and bathrooms. Encouraging service users to take responsibility for maintaining their own environment, and supporting them with laundry and cleaning tasks where appropriate. Night time security and monitoring of the building and its environs. Staffing reception area as necessary. Supervision of service users with particular attention to service users with high care needs and offering support when required. Where necessary and in conjunction with the nurse and the staff team, to support service users with their prescriptions and proper taking of medication as prescribed by their doctors and to adhere to their alcohol intake plans. To record and report any non-compliance of same. To encourage and support service users to develop skills in managing their daily living. To alert a member of the management team to any crisis or behaviour management issues and to use the On-call manager during out of hour’s times when necessary. In conjunction with project team, to assist residents with personal monies, service charge payments, etc where necessary. Carry out project administration tasks such as upkeep of petty cash, project statistics, invoices, record keeping, Service User’s files, OTIS, IR and AR completion etc. To ensure that Health and Safety standards are met within the project in accordance with Depaul’s Health and Safety policy and the projects Safety Statement. To undertake assigned duties regarding the overall health and safety and security of the service and to use security systems put in place. To work as a member of a multi-disciplined team in the best interests of the residents To attend and participate in team meetings and staff team days. To participate in regular supervision and annual appraisal, and help in identifying your own job-related development and training needs. To ensure that all Depaul policies and procedures are being adhered to, particularly those relating to Health and Safety, Code of Practice and Confidentiality. To contribute to the effective implementation of Depaul’s Equal Opportunities Policy as it affects both Depaul and its work with service users. The above list is not exhaustive; additional areas of responsibility may be added over time and flexibility to cover for other staff roles is required from time to time. Requirements: Have at least 1 years’ experience working in the homelessness field or another suitably related area, desirably in a residential setting OR Level 5 QQI qualification or above in social care, or a suitably related area.A Manual handling qualification would be desirable. Have an understanding of harm reduction and low threshold working Understand why people become homeless and the issues they present with, and what supports can be offered in services to service users with complex needs Understanding of risk management principles. Capable of responding calmly in a crisis and use your own initiative to deal with incidents as they arise Be able to work as part of a team understanding the importance of team communication Have an understanding of Health and Safety and the health and safety requirements within a residential setting working with homeless people. Have a knowledge and understanding of the vision, mission and values of Depaul

title: Construction - Engineering Summer Placement
description: Role Purpose Applications are open for voluntary Engineering Summer Placements with Glanua in Ireland and the United Kingdom. The placement is intended for students who want practical engineering experience during their semester break and are available from the start of June to the end of August. The opportunity is open to students across all engineering subjects, including civil, mechanical, electrical, chemical, environmental, process, structural, energy, automation and related disciplines. Students will join a suitable office, design, project or site team according to their course, interests, location and available business needs. Summer Placement Experience You will work alongside experienced engineers and project colleagues on live water, wastewater, bioresources or supporting infrastructure activities. Your work will be supervised and matched to your stage of study, giving you an introduction to professional engineering practice, project delivery, safety and teamwork. This is a general summer placement advert rather than a rotational programme. Placements will normally remain with one host team and location, although occasional visits to another office, project or site may be required. Specific responsibilities will vary by discipline and project needs. Key Responsibilities Engineering and Project Support Support engineers with drawings, calculations, specifications, schedules, technical records or other project information under supervision. Help collect, organise and review project data, site information, supplier details or asset records for use by the host team. Prepare clear notes, trackers, presentations and document updates using approved templates and project systems. Take part in design reviews, planning meetings or coordination activities appropriate to your discipline and stage of study. Design Delivery and Site Exposure Learn how engineering designs are developed, checked and translated into safe, practical solutions for water and wastewater projects. Assist with supervised site visits, surveys, inspections, commissioning preparation or progress records where relevant to the placement. Support quality, environmental and health and safety requirements by following instructions, completing records and raising questions promptly. Work with colleagues from different engineering and project disciplines and observe how teams coordinate clients, suppliers and construction activities. Learning Safety and Team Contribution Complete the induction, mandatory safety training and any role-specific learning required before carrying out placement activities. Attend team briefings, ask questions and use feedback from engineers, supervisors and project colleagues to improve your work. Contribute to a practical improvement, research task, technical summary or project deliverable agreed with the host team. Keep an accurate record of learning and experience that may support academic reflection, a placement report or future career planning. Our Values At Glanua, our values shape how we work together and how we serve our clients. We act with Respect towards our colleagues, clients and communities, and believe in the power of Collaboration to deliver the best outcomes for our teams and projects. We hold ourselves to a high standard of Accountability, taking ownership of our commitments, and act with Integrity in every decision we make. We pursue Excellence in everything we do, continuously improving how we design, build and operate, and we place Safety at the centre of our culture, ensuring the wellbeing of our people is never compromised. As an Engineering Summer Placement student, you will be expected to demonstrate these values in your day-to-day work and learning. Essential Criteria Currently enrolled in an engineering degree, diploma or equivalent programme at a recognised university, college or institute of technology. Seeking a voluntary summer placement during semester break and available from the start of June to the end of August. An interest in applying engineering knowledge to water, wastewater, environmental or related infrastructure projects. A basic understanding of engineering principles relevant to your course and a willingness to learn from other disciplines. Clear written and verbal communication skills, with good organisation and attention to detail. A responsible approach to health, safety, quality, the environment and confidential project information. Working knowledge of Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint, with confidence learning project or engineering systems. Ability to meet the right-to-work requirements for Ireland or the United Kingdom, as applicable, and to travel to the assigned office or project location. Desirable Criteria Academic project, laboratory, workshop, site, volunteering or previous work experience relevant to engineering. Familiarity with computer-aided design, modelling, data analysis, programming or other technical tools used in your discipline. An interest in sustainable infrastructure, resource recovery and the water sector. Personal Attributes Proactive, curious and eager to learn from experienced colleagues. Collaborative and respectful, with a positive approach to teamwork. Safety-conscious and willing to speak up when something does not look right. Adaptable and practical when working across different tasks, projects and environments. Organised and attentive to detail, with the confidence to ask questions and apply feedback. Diversity, Equity & Inclusion At Glanua, we are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone is treated with respect and has an equal opportunity to succeed. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and value the different perspectives and experiences they bring. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let our recruitment team know.

La figura entrerà a far parte della Direzione ICT e avrà la responsabilità di supervisionare e rafforzare la sicurezza informatica aziendale, contribuendo alla protezione di infrastrutture, sistemi e dati. Principali responsabilità Gestire sistemi, servizi e prodotti di cybersecurity e collaborare con le funzioni ICT per definire configurazioni sicure di apparati, servizi, sistemi e soluzioni. Applicare le procedure aziendali in materia di Qualità, Privacy e Compliance, segnalando tempestivamente eventuali scostamenti o irregolarità alle funzioni competenti. Progettare, implementare, verificare e documentare policy e procedure per proteggere l'infrastruttura informatica da minacce e violazioni della sicurezza. Implementare processi interni ed esterni di Vulnerability Assessment e monitorare l'efficacia dei controlli adottati. Individuare le vulnerabilità e coordinare le opportune azioni di remediation, tutelando la sicurezza della rete e dei dati. Sviluppare e attuare un piano almeno triennale per la messa in sicurezza dei sistemi informativi aziendali. Monitorare l'utilizzo dei sistemi ICT per verificarne la conformità alle policy di sicurezza. Mantenersi aggiornato/a sugli standard di sicurezza IT e sull'evoluzione delle minacce. Documentare le violazioni di sicurezza, valutarne gli impatti e sottoporre le evidenze agli organi competenti. Promuovere presso i colleghi dei Sistemi Informativi le migliori pratiche per la protezione delle informazioni. Organizzare il supporto del service desk per le tematiche di cybersecurity. Predisporre report periodici sullo stato della sicurezza aziendale per la Direzione ICT e il Board. Requisiti ed esperienza Esperienza di almeno 6-7 anni in ambito cybersecurity, maturata nella gestione tecnica di sistemi, servizi e soluzioni di sicurezza. Conoscenza approfondita di sistemi, servizi e prodotti di cybersecurity. Capacità di integrare e automatizzare soluzioni di sicurezza. Esperienza nella gestione tecnica di sistemi di cybersecurity, tra cui Identity Management, sicurezza e configurazione di rete, sistemi di monitoraggio, firewall e reverse proxy. Conoscenza delle principali normative e degli standard di settore, tra cui NIS2, GDPR, MDR, NIST e ISO. Capacità di collaborare efficacemente con team IT/OT e con le diverse funzioni aziendali. Missione del ruolo La risorsa si occuperà, in base al livello di autonomia e competenze maturate, di diagnosi, ricerca guasti, manutenzione, riparazione e collaudo dei veicoli, intervenendo su sistemi meccanici, elettrici ed elettronici, incluse le vetture elettrificate e BEV. Cosa farai Eseguirai attività di diagnosi strutturata e ricerca guasti, individuando la causa primaria delle anomalie e definendo gli interventi correttivi necessari. Effettuerai interventi di manutenzione ordinaria e straordinaria, riparazione e sostituzione componenti su tutta la gamma. Svolgerai verifiche e controlli su motore, trasmissione, freni, sterzo, sospensioni e sui principali sistemi elettrici/elettronici e ADAS. Applicherai manuali e procedure tecniche del costruttore e le regole di sicurezza previste per le lavorazioni. Opererai su veicoli elettrificati/BEV e, se in possesso delle qualifiche, su sistemi ad alta tensione, nel rispetto delle procedure di sicurezza. Eseguirai controlli, misurazioni, regolazioni, programmazioni e verifiche funzionali post-intervento (incluse prove su strada dove previste). Documenterai in modo accurato diagnosi e attività svolte, garantendo tracciabilità e fornendo indicazioni tecniche chiare all'Accettazione. Collaborerai con Magazzino Ricambi per identificazione e disponibilità componenti e supporterai, per quanto di competenza, la gestione pratiche garanzia. Lavorerai in sinergia con il team e parteciperai a programmi di formazione/aggiornamento per restare allineato all'evoluzione tecnologica (elettrificazione, elettronica, diagnostica, sistemi digitali). Esperienza significativa nel settore automotive in ruoli di tecnico meccanico/meccatronico/diagnostico/officina. Solida conoscenza dei sistemi meccanici, elettrici ed elettronici del veicolo. Buona capacità di diagnosi e ricerca guasti con strumentazione. Conoscenza dei principi di funzionamento di tecnologie elettrificate e BEV (batterie, ricarica, alta tensione); qualifiche specifiche HV preferenziali. Buona familiarità con strumenti informatici e diagnostici automotive. Capacità di consultare e applicare documentazione e procedure tecniche. Patente B. Preferenziale familiarità con gare/tender e processi di acquisto strutturati (pubblici o grandi account). Approccio tecnico-commerciale. Disponibilità a viaggiare nei Paesi assegnati (indicativamente 30-50%). Ottime doti relazionali, orientamento a obiettivi, autonomia e capacità di lavorare per priorità (anche in contesti urgenti). title: dirigente delle risorse umane
description: Direttore Generale Azienda di servizi SW & HW - Information Technology | Piccola Impresa Wyser ricerca un Direttore Generale per una PI (piccola impresa) italiana a proprietà imprenditoriale, attiva nell'erogazione di servizi SW&HW ICT a imprese ed enti pubblici. L'azienda offre soluzioni SW & HW per infrastrutture e reti, cloud, cybersecurity e assistenza IT, integrate con fornitura e noleggio di tecnologie hardware e software. Si distingue per la relazione continuativa con i clienti e per un approccio da boutique orientato alla qualità del servizio. Il ruolo Il Direttore Generale affiancherà la proprietà nella definizione e nell'attuazione della strategia aziendale, assumendo la responsabilità del coordinamento complessivo delle attività e del raggiungimento degli obiettivi concordati. Contribuirà al rafforzamento dell'organizzazione e all'evoluzione dell'offerta, con attenzione alla redditività, all'innovazione tecnologica e allo sviluppo delle persone. Principali responsabilità Definire con la proprietà il piano di sviluppo aziendale e tradurlo in obiettivi, budget e priorità operative, monitorandone l'attuazione e proponendo eventuali azioni correttive. Migliorare il modello organizzativo, i processi e gli strumenti di pianificazione e controllo, introducendo responsabilità chiare e indicatori di performance a supporto delle decisioni. Presidiare i risultati economici e gestionali, in collaborazione con la funzione amministrativa, attraverso l'analisi di ricavi, costi, marginalità di progetti e servizi, investimenti e impiego delle risorse. Coordinare le funzioni commerciali, tecniche e operative, assicurando coerenza tra obiettivi di vendita, capacità di erogazione e qualità del servizio al cliente. Sviluppare il business consolidando le relazioni con i clienti strategici, individuando nuove opportunità e favorendo una maggiore integrazione dell'offerta per imprese ed enti pubblici. Guidare l'evoluzione del portafoglio di soluzioni e servizi, valutando tecnologie emergenti e applicazioni dell'intelligenza artificiale in funzione delle esigenze del mercato e del ritorno economico. Valorizzare e sviluppare le competenze dei collaboratori, promuovendo collaborazione tra team, responsabilizzazione e condivisione delle conoscenze. Gestire e sviluppare le relazioni con vendor e partner strategici, collaborando con le funzioni competenti al presidio della qualità, della sicurezza delle informazioni e della compliance. Requisiti e competenze Esperienza in ruoli di direzione generale, direzione di business unit o responsabilità manageriale trasversale nel settore dei servizi, preferibilmente presso system integrator o provider di servizi IT, in alternativa altri servizi B2B es. Digital, TLC... Responsabilità maturata nella gestione di risultati economici, budget e team, con capacità di integrare visione strategica ed esecuzione operativa. Conoscenza del mercato ICT e dei modelli di business legati a progetti, servizi ricorrenti e soluzioni tecnologiche; capacità di valutarne marginalità, complessità operativa e potenziale di sviluppo. Preparazione tecnologica adeguata a confrontarsi con gli specialisti su infrastrutture, networking, cloud e cybersecurity e a orientare le scelte di offerta e investimento. Esperienza nel miglioramento di processi e organizzazione, con capacità di introdurre metodi e strumenti gestionali proporzionati alle esigenze di una piccola impresa. Capacità di costruire un rapporto di fiducia con la proprietà, condividere le priorità e rendicontare con chiarezza risultati, criticità e proposte. Costituiranno elementi preferenziali l'esperienza in contesti imprenditoriali o familiari e la partecipazione a percorsi di evoluzione manageriale. Saranno valorizzate anche la conoscenza del mercato pubblico e dei modelli di noleggio tecnologico. La ricerca è aperta anche a figure provenienti da ruoli di direzione Sales & Delivery, Operations o Commerciale, purché abbiano maturato responsabilità effettive su organizzazione, persone e risultati economici, oltre allo sviluppo delle vendite. Lo stile manageriale Cerchiamo una persona autorevole e concreta, capace di ascoltare, comprendere il contesto e accompagnare il cambiamento in modo costruttivo. Saranno centrali la capacità di coinvolgere collaboratori esperti, prendere decisioni e tradurre le opportunità tecnologiche in iniziative sostenibili per il business. L'opportunità professionale Il ruolo offre la possibilità di contribuire direttamente alla direzione e all'evoluzione di una piccola impresa ICT, lavorando a stretto contatto con la proprietà e incidendo sulle scelte organizzative, commerciali e tecnologiche. Il progetto valorizza una figura manageriale capace di coniugare sviluppo del business, qualità del servizio e continuità delle relazioni con clienti e collaboratori. Retribuzione: 90.000€ -120.000€ in base all'esperienza del profillo Auto aziendale Location: Ufficio collocato nella provincia di Varese Sud-est #LI-AM Wyser S.r.l. è autorizzata ad operare dal Ministero del Lavoro e delle Politiche Sociali (Aut. Min. del 15/04/2014 Prot. N: 39/4903) e si occupa di ricerca e selezione di profili manageriali ed executive. L'offerta si intende rivolta a candidati e candidate, nel rispetto del D.Lgs. n. 198/2006 e ss.mm.ii. e dei Decreti Legislativi n. 215 e n. 216 del 2003 sulle parità di trattamento. title: Principle Engineer for early failure mechanisms, methodologies and tools (f/m/div) - HRC1792713 (Ingenieur/in - Elektrotechnik)
description: #WeAreIn for jobs that impact everyone's life.Driving continuous improvement - ready to make quality a culture?As a Principle Engineer for early failure mechanisms, methodologies and tools (f/m/div) in our Quality & Excellence team uncover the root causes behind every single error, drive transformational improvements, and implement forward-thinking solutions to ensure our products exceed the highest standards of quality, reliability, and performance. Are you in?Your roleKey responsibilities in your new role- Act as the technical lead and methodological expert for Burn-in (BI), including steering BI decisions, driving continuous improvements, and serving as the primary interface to technology and product development as well as statistics teams- Provide teaching, coaching, and knowledge transfer on Burn-in topics to cross-functional teams, ensuring a consistent and high-quality understanding of BI methodologies across the organization- Support Design for Stress (DfS) sustaining activities, including the management and resolution of DfS Jira Tickets in close collaboration with relevant stakeholders- Serve as the 1st level of support for internal customer inquiries, with a particular focus on** Automotive Governance**, ensuring timely and solution-oriented responses- Drive long-term, strategically important tasks that require sustained attention, ensuring that critical but non-urgent topics receive appropriate prioritization and follow-through- Collaborate closely with Front-End (FE), Back-End (BE) and product development teams, contributing expert knowledge on failure mechanisms, defects, design and test conditions to support informed quality decisions- Lead customer communications about early topics- Contribute to the continuous improvement of Quality Management Systems (QMS), processes, methods, and tools along the entire supply chain, with a strong automotive quality mindsetYour profileQualifications and skills to help you succeed - A degree in Electrical Engineering, Microelectronics, Materials Science, Physics, or a related field- At least 6 years of professional work experience in semiconductor manufacturing, with a strong focus on quality management along the supply chain, Front-End and Back-End processes, and reliability testing- Expert-level knowledge in Burn-in methodologies, including deep understanding of physical failure mechanisms, defect analysis, Fault Analysis (FA), and test conditions relevant to semiconductor devices- Proven experience as a technical lead in a cross-functional environment, with the ability to drive decisions, align stakeholders, and manage Design for Stress (DfS) activities effectively- Solid understanding of wafer manufacturing process, foundational skills in data analysis, and familiarity with chip design, test engineering and product development processes- Proficiency in digital collaboration tools such as Confluence, Jira, and Intranet platforms- Show a strong automotive quality mindset and knowledge about automotive requirements- Outstanding interpersonal skills and a genuine service provider attitude, with demonstrated ability to coach, teach, and inspire colleagues while fostering a collaborative and inclusive team culture- Fluent English (written and spoken); German is a plusPlease send us your CV in EnglishPlease note that:- Subject to meeting all job requirements, belonging to protected categories under Law 68/69 will be considered a preferential requirementAdditional information by locationAustriaWe offer competitive salaries and additional benefits based on your performance, experience, and qualification. The employment is in accordance with the collective salary and wage agreement for employees of the electrical and electronics industry, employment group H,I (https://www.feei.at/aktuelles/mindestloehne-und-gehaelter-eei/ (https://www.feei.at/aktuelles/mindestloehne-und-gehaelter-eei/) ). The monthly salary is paid 14 times p.a. We offer a higher compensation depending on your expertise and skills.Salary pay information:In line with local legal requirements, indicative salary ranges are disclosed for selected locations where applicable.LocationIndicative salary rangePadova, Italy*€52,000 – €71,500*The stated salary comprises annual base pay and target variable compensation. The starting salary is determined using objective, gender neutral criteria, including relevant experience, qualifications, and role scope; prior compensation is not requested or considered. Employees also benefit from a comprehensive total rewards package, which may include further compensation and benefit elements depending on local regulations and company policies.#WeAreIn for driving decarbonization and digitalization.As a global leader in semiconductor solutions in power systems and IoT, Infineon enables game-changing solutions for green and efficient energy, clean and safe mobility, as well as smart and secure IoT. Together, we drive innovation and customer success, while caring for our people and empowering them to reach ambitious goals. Be a part of making life easier, safer and greener.Are you in?We are on a journey to create the best Infineon for everyone.We strive to create the best Infineon for everyone by embracing diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants for who they are and offer a workplace built on trust, openness, respect and equal opportunity. Our hiring decisions are based on skills and experience. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply.Please let your recruiter know if you need any accommodations during the interview process.Learn more about our various contact channels (https://www.infineon.com/cms/en/about-infineon/company/contacts/)  and about Diversity & Inclusion (https://www.infineon.com/cms/en/careers/diversity-and-inclusion/)  at Infineon.HRC1792713

title: Fahrer (m/w/divers) für Showtruck gesucht (Berufskraftfahrer/in)
description: .....gesucht wird ein "bewirtender" Berufskraftfahrer oder "kundenorientierter" Gastronom mit Lkw-Führerschein.....Wir suchen einen zuverlässigen und erfahrenen Lkw-Fahrer mit Führerschein C/CE für unseren Showtruck, der sich um die sichere und effiziente Beförderung unserer Gastronomie-Einrichtung kümmert und nahezu ganzjährig unterwegs ist, insbesondere in Italien und Frankreich.Als Lkw-Fahrer werden Sie für die Bedienung und Wartung des Fahrzeugs verantwortlich sein und sicherstellen, dass alle Aufgaben im Zusammenhang mit dem Auf- und Abbau der Gastronomie-Einrichtung reibungslos durchgeführt werden. Zu Ihren Hauptaufgaben gehören die Fahrt zu den Veranstaltungsorten, der Auf- und Abbau der Einrichtung, der Ausschank und die Betreuung der Gäste. Wir suchen einen Kandidaten mit ausgeprägten Fahrkenntnissen, excellenten Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und einer tiefen Erfahrung im Umgang mit Lkw und Gastronomie-Einrichtungen.Die Stelle erfordert eine hohe Flexibilität und die Bereitschaft, nahezu ganzjährig unterwegs zu sein. Wenn Sie eine Herausforderung suchen und sich für eine abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit begeistern, dann sind Sie bei uns richtig.Zum Aufgabengebiet gehören voraussichtlich aber nicht ausschließlich:- Mitreisetätigkeit an 6-10 Monaten am Stück im Jahr, ausdehnbar auf 12 Monate im Jahr, wenn erste Teilsaison stimmt- Erfahrung im Betrieb/Mitreisen bei Schaustellerbetrieben, Eventbereich- leichter Auf- und Abbau von Gerätschaften während der Tour- Eventunterstützung von Organisation vor Ort- Terminplanung Tour- Ausschankbetrieb- Führerschein Klasse CEPersönliche Voraussetzungen:- Unabhängigkeit- Altersvorgabe 30-58- technisches Verständnis Light&Sound und LKW-Technik- englisch fließend, jede weitere Fremdsprache ist willkommen- Persönlichkeit: präsent, kommunikativ, selbstbewusstInteresse? Bitte teilen Sie uns mit, wenn Sie weitere Fragen haben oder wenn Sie sich für diese Stelle interessieren.Ergänzende Informationen:Anforderungen an den Bewerber: Grundkenntnisse: Getränke zubereiten und anrichten, Fahrzeugführung, Gästebetreuung, Technisches Verständnis

title: commerciante all’ingrosso
description: Grafton Office* è un team dedicato a valorizzare le esperienze, le competenze e il potenziale dei candidati in ambito Accounting, Sales, Marketing, HR, Legal, Purchasing and Office Management. Siamo un team di professionisti appassionati, lavoriamo per accompagnare i nostri candidati verso le mansioni ed i contesti aziendali più coerenti con le loro competenze e le loro aspettative. Per importante azienda cliente ricerchiamo: Buying Planner La risorsa, inserita all'interno dell'Ufficio Buying e in collaborazione con i Buyer e la Direzione Commerciale, supporterà le attività di pianificazione, monitoraggio e gestione operativa degli ordini, contribuendo all'ottimizzazione della disponibilità del prodotto, della rotazione delle scorte e della marginalità. Nello specifico, la figura inserita si occuperà di: Monitorare le performance di vendita dei prodotti, analizzando sell-in, sell-out, stock, rotazioni, stock coverage e marginalità per categoria, brand, linea e punto vendita, individuando trend, criticità e opportunità commerciali; Supportare la pianificazione degli assortimenti e dei fabbisogni di prodotto per insegna, categoria, stagione e canale distributivo, sulla base dei dati storici, previsionali e degli obiettivi commerciali; Supportare il team Buying nella definizione dei quantitativi di acquisto e nella costruzione dell'assortimento; Monitorare il ciclo di vita del prodotto, dall'ingresso in assortimento fino alla fase di fine stagione, individuando eventuali criticità e opportunità di intervento; Analizzare le giacenze e individuare tempestivamente situazioni di overstock, understock e slow moving, supportando la definizione delle relative azioni correttive; Supportare il team Buying, in collaborazione con Planning & Allocation, nell'individuazione delle esigenze di riassortimento e redistribuzione del prodotto; Monitorare l'andamento dei budget di acquisto e degli obiettivi economici assegnati alle diverse categorie merceologiche, segnalando eventuali scostamenti; Gestire operativamente l'inserimento, l'emissione e l'aggiornamento degli ordini di acquisto a sistema, assicurando la correttezza delle informazioni relative a prodotti, quantità, prezzi e condizioni concordate; Monitorare l'avanzamento degli ordini, verificando conferme d'ordine, variazioni, cancellazioni ed eventuali anomalie e interfacciandosi con i fornitori per gli aspetti operativi; Presidiare il follow-up delle consegne e il rispetto delle tempistiche previste, segnalando tempestivamente eventuali ritardi o scostamenti rispetto alla pianificazione e garantendo l'allineamento tra piano di acquisto, ordini emessi e merce in consegna; Predisporre e mantenere aggiornata la reportistica relativa a ordini, budget impegnato, consegne, stock e performance di prodotto, fornendo analisi a supporto dell'Ufficio Buying e della Direzione Commerciale. Requisiti richiesti: Laurea in discipline economiche, statistiche, gestionali, moda o affini. Esperienza pregressa di almeno 2-3 anni in ruoli di Buying Planning, Merchandise Planning, Buying, Merchandising o Product Management, preferibilmente nel settore fashion retail. Conoscenza delle logiche di assortimento, pianificazione e gestione dello stock nel settore retail. Spiccata capacità di analisi e interpretazione dei dati. Utilizzo avanzato di Excel; gradita la conoscenza di strumenti di Business Intelligence. Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese. Completano il profilo: approccio analitico e commerciale, capacità di lettura delle performance di prodotto, ottime capacità organizzative e di pianificazione, precisione, problem solving, Sede di lavoro: Palermo, Orari: Lun-Ven 8:30 - 13:00 / 14:30 - 18:00 CCNL Commercio Range Retributivo previsto: € 23.300 - € 27.000. Il posizionamento all'interno della fascia sarà determinato sulla base delle competenze e dell'esperienza professionale coerenti con i requisiti della posizione. *Grafton Office è una specializzazione di Gi Group Spa autorizzata ad operare dal Ministero del Lavoro e delle Politiche Sociali (Aut.Min. 26/11/2004 PROT. 1101 - SG). title: commerciante all’ingrosso
description: Il nostro cliente è una realtà italiana solida e strutturata attiva nelle grandi opere/infrastrutture, con forte presidio su cantieri, impianti e mezzi , che ci ha incaricato di ricercare per la sede di Sondrio un/una SENIOR BUYER - Lavori/Servizi/Forniture | Grandi Opere/Infrastrutture (Sondrio) La risorsa riporterà al Responsabile Ufficio Acquisti e avrà il compito di assicurare l'attività di approvvigionamento di lavori, servizi e forniture in ambito grandi opere e infrastrutture pubbliche, in funzione delle esigenze produttive dei cantieri per la parte plant & equipment. Nello specifico, la risorsa: Gestisce l'albo fornitori: selezione, aggiornamento e proposta di approvazione in linea con procedure interne. Prepara e invia le richieste di offerta, raccoglie le proposte e coordina le verifiche tecniche con le funzioni richiedenti. segue la negoziazione economica e contrattuale (tempi, condizioni, SLA), con attenzione a qualità, lead time e ottimizzazione costi. Desideriamo entrare in contatto con Senior Buyers in possesso di laurea in Ingegneria (Civile, Gestionale, Edile, Meccanica, dei Processi) oppure Diploma di Geometra con esperienza negli acquisti legati ai cantieri, in particolare su impianti e macchinari, materiali, ricambi e servizi (es. manutenzioni) e provenienza da contesti strutturati (ad es società di infrastrutture/costruzioni, EPC contractors, Oil & Gas, aziende produttrici di mezzi di movimentazione/sollevamento). È richiesta la conoscenza della normativa sugli Appalti Pubblici, una buona padronanza del pacchetto Office (soprattutto Excel) e, preferibilmente, familiarità con sistemi ERP (SAP). Completano il profilo autonomia operativa, capacità di lavorare in team e orientamento al risultato. Sede di lavoro: Sondrio con smart working 8 gg/mese. È richiesta motivazione al trasferimento; è previsto un pacchetto di relocation (inclusa foresteria, contributo spese viaggio) Wyser S.r.l. è autorizzata ad operare dal Ministero del Lavoro e delle Politiche Sociali (Aut. Min. del 15/04/2014 Prot. N: 39/4903) e si occupa di ricerca e selezione di profili manageriali ed executive. L'offerta si intende rivolta a candidati e candidate, nel rispetto del D.Lgs. n. 198/2006 e ss.mm.ii. e dei Decreti Legislativi n. 215 e n. 216 del 2003 sulle parità di trattamento. title: geologo/geologa
description: Grafton Engineering* è un team dedicato a valorizzare le esperienze, le competenze e il potenziale dei candidati in ambito Progettazione, Logistica e Supply Chain, Production&Maintenance, Qualità - Sicurezza e Ambiente, Process & Project Management. Per Azienda internazionale, leader nella progettazione e costruzione di macchinari per la produzione industriale, Automazione, Robotica e Converting, selezioniamo: SOFTWARE ENGINEER - Automation & Robotics Di cosa ti occuperai? Inserito/a nel reparto Engineering, contribuirai allo sviluppo di soluzioni software avanzate per macchine e impianti automatici, integrando automazione, robotica e visione artificiale, con focus su performance, affidabilità e sicurezza. In particolare ti occuperai di: Analisi di richieste tecniche post-vendita (upgrade, miglioramenti, bug fixing) e supporto alla definizione della soluzione (fattibilità e impatti). Sviluppo & commissioning automazione: PLC, Motion, HMI/SCADA (Siemens/Rockwell/Beckhoff/Codesys). Test/validazione/ottimizzazione in collaborazione con i referenti tecnici di plant. Troubleshooting e analisi di anomalie con approccio strutturato (raccolta evidenze, riproducibilità, proposta di fix). Produzione/aggiornamento della documentazione tecnica (specifiche di base, note di rilascio, report test). Collaborazione con team cross-funzionali (meccanica, elettrica, automazione) per integrazione e miglioramento continuo Hai queste competenze e caratteristiche? Laurea in Ingegneria (Automazione/Robotica/Informatica/Meccatronica/Elettrica-Elettronica o affini); gradita magistrale/specializzazione AI-Vision. 2-5 anni di esperienza in sviluppo software per automazione industriale, macchine/impianti, o sistemi complessi in contesti industriali. Programmazione: C++ e/o C# e/o Python; graditi OOP, UML, Design Patterns, DBMS. Familiarità con contesti di automazione industriale e integrazione software-hardware; gradita conoscenza di protocolli/fieldbus e ambienti Linux. Soft skills: analisi, problem solving, teamwork, collaborazione cross-funzionale. Inglese buono/fluente. Orario di lavoro: Full time 40 ore settimanali, dal lunedì al venerdì. Richiesta presenza in plant, con con possibilità di smart working fino a 8 giorni al mese. Offerta Contrattuale: Inserimento con contratto a tempo indeterminato; CCNL applicato: Metalmeccanico; Livello di inquadramento: B2. La retribuzione prevista è compresa tra € 35.000 e € 45.000 lordi annui (RAL), definita in base all'inquadramento, alle mansioni e alle caratteristiche del profilo. Sono inoltre previsti mensa aziendale, piano welfare, pacchetto benefit dedicato alla cura della persona e formazione tecnica continua sulle tecnologie avanzate utilizzate all'interno del reparto Engineering. Sede di lavoro: San Giovanni Teatino (CH), con contributo mensile alla relocation per candidati/e provenienti da fuori regione. Se pensi di avere le competenze e l'attitudine per questo ruolo, inviaci la tua candidatura! title: ingegnere meccanico
description: Grafton Engineering is a team dedicated to enhancing the experience, skills and potential of candidates in Design, Logistics & Supply Chain, Production&Maintenance, Quality - Safety & Environment, Process & Project Management. Saipem Spa is a global leader in engineering and construction for the energy and infrastructure sectors, delivering complex onshore and offshore projects worldwide. Driven by technological innovation as 'One Company', our 30,000 people from over 130 nationalities in more than 50 countries work every day to enable the energy transition toward Net Zero. At Saipem, we embrace diversity as a driver of innovation and inclusion, while prioritizing people's safety and environmental sustainability, even in the most challenging conditions. As Maintenance Engineering Specialist you will respond to the Maintenance Engineering Lead and be part of the Energy Carriers Business Line within EPC Maintenance and Inspection Engineering Department. Job includes plant reliability analysis, equipment criticality assessment and maintenance plan development. Scope of the work involves activities ranging from acknowledging of process-related conditions and evaluating the equipment detail design. Maintenance Engineering Specialist (MES) is to make sure that the project detailed design is safe and sound from an operation and maintenance point of view, complies with the international standards and meet the requirements arising from contract and technical specification therein referred to. In performing his job, the MES is liaising with client representatives, partners, suppliers and project team. MES regularly reports to the Commissioning, Operation and Maintenance manager the status of the Maintenance Engineering assessment, highlighting areas of concern. How can you support us? supporting the maintenance engineering lead in reviewing the project technical documentation in respect to the contractual requirements, gathering of maintenance related design data from technical disciplines and vendors to build-up a comprehensive plant asset register which includes all the maintainable equipment, preparation of Maintainable Equipment List (MEL) hierarchically organized by functional location which in turn refer to physical asset; operability and maintainability review, support mechanical handling assessment, equipment criticality analysis (ECA) to rank item listed in MEL in view of safety, environment and production requirement, maintenance strategies, procedures, and tasks according to either the original equipment manufacturer data or the results of the performed Reliability Centered Maintenance (RCM) analysis; operational performance standard preparation; CMMS loading templates preparation Education: Master's Degree/bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering or similar qualification Experience: 5+ years of experience in the Oil & Gas industry Languages: English level B2/C1 What else should you know? Some travelling will be expected within EMEA, Africa, etc What we can offer to you: Permanent Contract, CCNL Energia e Petrolio For home office contract: Pay not lower than 43000€ Corporate Benefits: We offer a comprehensive benefits package, including health insurance, internal gym, discounts and partnerships, services related to health, family, well-being, and in-house cafeteria. Hybrid working model: Smart Working options and flexible hours to help you achieve a better work-life balance. title: Database and network professionals
description: Gi Group SpA, Agenzia per il Lavoro (Aut. Min. 26/11/04 Prot. N. 1101-SG), Multinazionale Italiana Leader nei Servizi per le Risorse Umane con oltre 200 filiali sul territorio nazionale e più di 1800 professionisti nel settore delle Risorse Umane, Ricerca per conto di Cineca Consorzio Interuniversitario Data Specialist Cineca è una delle realtà di riferimento in Italia e in Europa per supercalcolo, innovazione digitale e servizi tecnologici avanzati. Per rafforzare il team, siamo alla ricerca di una figura di Data Specialist che contribuisca alla gestione, analisi e valorizzazione dei dati aziendali, con particolare riferimento agli ambiti di contabilità e controllo di gestione, supportando la realizzazione di soluzioni di Analytics e Data Platform e l'evoluzione dei relativi flussi e piattaforme dati. Il ruolo: Entrerai in un team che lavora sul dato lungo tutto il suo ciclo di vita, dalla trasformazione alla visualizzazione, con un focus specifico sugli ambiti amministrativi e di controllo. Non si tratta di un ruolo orientato esclusivamente alla reportistica descrittiva: cerchiamo una figura capace di interpretare il dato, valorizzarlo e contribuire anche ad analisi evolute e simulazioni, diventando un punto di riferimento per il proprio perimetro. Ti occuperai di: gestire, trasformare e valorizzare i dati a supporto degli ambiti di contabilità e controllo di gestione; supportare la realizzazione di soluzioni di Analytics e Data Platform; contribuire alla costruzione e all'evoluzione di flussi dati su Data Lake e Data Warehouse; sviluppare dashboard e strumenti di visualizzazione per la lettura e l'utilizzo del dato; contribuire ad analisi evolute e modelli previsionali a supporto delle esigenze di business; collaborare con il team tecnico e con gli stakeholder di riferimento per l'evoluzione dei flussi e delle piattaforme dati. Cerchiamo una persona con almeno 2 anni di esperienza in ambito Analytics e Big Data, maturata su tematiche di contabilità e controllo di gestione. Sono inoltre importanti: Diploma o laurea in ambito scientifico, informatico, statistico o affine; buona conoscenza di SQL e Python; familiarità con linguaggi come Scala e R; esperienza nella costruzione di flussi su Data Lake su DWH; conoscenza di strumenti di Data Visualization e BI, come Power BI e Pentaho; familiarità con librerie per lo sviluppo di modelli e analisi avanzate, come Scikit-Learn, TensorFlow, Keras, e con approcci di AI/ML; conoscenza di almeno un linguaggio di scripting, come Bash o PowerShell; esperienza con pratiche di CI/CD; conoscenza di Git per versionamento del codice, branching e merging; familiarità con architetture Big Data e ambienti cloud, come Azure, AWS, GCP, o con tecnologie di data processing come Spark / Databricks; capacità di problem solving; attitudine al lavoro in team e alla collaborazione; buone capacità comunicative e relazionali. Costituiscono un plus: Supervisione delle pipeline di sviluppo; esperienza nella gestione consulenziale di progetti di ambito; Automazione dei processi di ingestion, trasformazione e deployment; familiarità con logging, monitoring e meccanismi di recovery delle pipeline. Entrare in Cineca significa lavorare in una realtà solida e orientata all'innovazione, dove la tecnologia ha un impatto reale e tangibile. Troverai: un contesto strutturato ma dinamico; progetti e servizi ad alta complessità tecnologica; un ambiente collaborativo, con forte attenzione al teamwork; onboarding dedicato e percorso di inserimento strutturato; opportunità di crescita per chi ha voglia di esporsi e portare contributo; flessibilità oraria, smart working e un sistema di welfare attento alle persone. Non cerchiamo qualcuno che si limiti a leggere il dato: cerchiamo chi voglia interpretarlo, trasformarlo e valorizzarlo. Se vuoi lavorare su analytics, piattaforme dati e soluzioni ad alto impatto, questo è il momento giusto per portare il tuo contributo in Cineca!
