title: Responsable énergie du parc immobilier
description: --- base: meta-keywords: meta-viewport: width=device-width, title: Responsable énergie du parc immobilier --- Responsable énergie du parc immobilier ======================================= Entité organisationnelle Division Bâtiments Logistique Fonction Ingénieur\\-e ets spécialiste Code fonction 104020 Classe maximum 17 Corps Personnel administratif et technique Taux d'activité 100% Délai d'inscription Référence 7133 Description du poste -------------------- L'Université de Genève exploite un parc immobilier de plus de 200'000 m², comprenant des bâtiments d'enseignement, de recherche avec des infrastructures techniques complexes en sciences et en médecine. Avec un budget énergétique d'environ 18 MCHF/an et un niveau de consommation parmi les plus élevés du canton, la maîtrise de l'énergie constitue un enjeu stratégique majeur. Dans un contexte de transition énergétique, de tension sur les coûts d'exploitation et de complexité croissante des installations, l'Université crée un poste de Responsable énergie afin de renforcer sa capacité interne à piloter la performance énergétique, maîtriser durablement ses coûts et conduire la transformation environnementale de son parc immobilier. Votre mission ------------- À l'échelle de l'Université, vous pilotez la performance énergétique et environnementale du parc immobilier. Vous intervenez de manière transverse sur les bâtiments en propriété, en location ainsi que sur les bâtiments exploités par des tiers lorsque l'Université supporte les charges énergétiques. Votre rôle a une double finalité : maîtriser durablement les consommations et les coûts énergétiques et conduire la réduction de l'empreinte environnementale du parc dans une trajectoire de décarbonation. Vous identifiez les leviers d'optimisation, priorisez les actions, pilotez leur mise en œuvre et suivez leurs résultats. Selon les périmètres, vous pilotez directement des projets d'amélioration énergétique des installations ou en assurez la coordination avec les partenaires compétents, notamment l'OCBA. Rattaché\\-e au secteur Exploitation du Service immobilier de la Division des bâtiments et logistique, vous assumez les responsabilités principales suivantes : \* Vous assurez le pilotage global des consommations et des dépenses énergétiques du parc, avec un objectif clair de réduction des coûts et de production d'économies mesurables. \* Vous conduisez des démarches d'optimisation énergétique bâtiment par bâtiment, en propre ou avec l'appui de mandataires spécialisés, et travaillez en étroite coordination avec les responsables techniques --- Exploitation bâtiments. \* Vous accompagnez les utilisateurs, notamment dans les bâtiments techniques, les laboratoires et les infrastructures complexes, afin de rationaliser les besoins et d'optimiser les usages énergétiques sans compromettre les exigences de recherche, d'enseignement ou d'exploitation. \* Vous identifiez, priorisez et pilotez des projets d'amélioration énergétique des installations, tels que le remplacement d'équipements, la modernisation d'installations techniques, l'optimisation de systèmes existants ou le déploiement de productions renouvelables. \* Vous structurez les données énergétiques du parc, développez les outils de suivi utiles au pilotage, produisez des analyses techniques et économiques, appuyez la direction dans ses arbitrages et pilotez le suivi des indicateurs énergie et CO₂ et structurez la trajectoire de décarbonation du parc, en lien avec les objectifs institutionnels. Le\\-la titulaire peut être appelé\\-e à d'autres missions en fonction des besoins du Service. Titre et compétences exigés ----------------------------- \* Vous êtes titulaire d'une formation supérieure HES ou équivalente en ingénierie énergie, CVSE, thermique du bâtiment ou domaine apparenté, et disposez d'une expérience confirmée d'au moins cinq ans dans l'exploitation technique de bâtiments complexes ou dans le pilotage énergétique d'un parc immobilier important. \* Vous savez analyser des consommations, transformer des données en décisions, conduire des démarches d'optimisation et piloter des projets techniques en environnement multi\\-acteurs. Vous êtes à l'aise à l'interface entre terrain, exploitation, mandataires, usagers et direction. Vous combinez rigueur analytique, sens des priorités, autonomie et orientation résultats. Une bonne compréhension des environnements scientifiques, techniques ou hospitalo\\-universitaires constitue un atout important. Entrée en fonction ------------------- 15 janvier 2027 Contact ------- Des renseignements complémentaires peuvent être obtenus auprès de l'adresse courriel : \[rh\\-dibat@\]() Informations complémentaires ----------------------------- Contrat : CDD de 1 an, renouvelable, sous fonds DIP. Lieu d'exercice : ensemble des sites de l'UNIGE, avec déplacements réguliers. Les candidatures comportant une lettre de motivation, un CV, les copies des diplômes et des certificats de travail doivent être déposées exclusivement en ligne en cliquant sur le boution ci\\-dessous "Postuler/Apply now". Aucune candidature papier ou envoyée par courriel ne sera prise en compte. L'Université de Genève offre des conditions d'engagement motivantes dans un cadre de travail stimulant. En nous rejoignant, vous aurez l'occasion de mettre en valeur vos compétences ainsi que votre personnalité et contribuer activement au rayonnement d'une Institution fondée en 1559\\. \*Dans une perspective de parité, l'Université encourage les candidatures du sexe sous\\-représenté.\* \[\](\< \>) !\[Université de Genève\]( ) \* Université de Genève Rue Michel\\-Servet 1 1211 Geneve \* \[\](\<\>) jpid287d530jm jpit1146jm jpiy26jm

ce délai est porté à 5 ans pour tout retrait supérieur à 3 mois \* Ne présenter aucune inscription au casier judiciaire\\\* \*\*Vos atouts pour réussir dans le métier\*\* \* Vous disposez déjà d'une expérience dans la conduite professionnelle de transport de personnes \* Même en tant que conducteur\\-rice expérimenté\\-e, vous êtes prêt\\-e à suivre un parcours de formation de trois mois et à adapter vos pratiques aux exigences du réseau tl \* Vous avez le sens du service, appréciez les contacts humains et faites preuve d'aisance relationnelle \* Vous êtes capable de gérer des situations complexes ou imprévues avec calme et professionnalisme \* Vous êtes disposé\\-e à travailler en horaires irréguliers \*\*Votre candidature\*\* Merci de joindre à votre candidature un \*\*dossier complet\*\* comprenant: \* Votre CV à jour et votre lettre de motivation \* Vos certificats de travail ou attestations de travail \* Une copie de votre permis de conduire D suisse recto/verso \* Un extrait SIAC\\\*\\\*, anciennement ADMAS, datant de moins de 3 mois \* Une copie recto/verso de votre autorisation de séjour ou de votre carte d'identité suisse \* Si titulaire, une copie de votre carte OACP \*\*Avant de postuler, merci de vous assurer que votre dossier contient l'ensemble des documents demandés. Les candidatures incomplètes ne seront pas prises en compte et devront faire l'objet d'une nouvelle candidature.\*\* \*\\\*Nos conditions d'emploi exigent un casier judiciaire vierge. Le justificatif de casier judiciaire n'est pas obligatoire au moment de la postulation, mais sera demandé en cours de processus de sélection.\* \*\\\*\\\*L'extrait SIAC est un document officiel attestant des antécédents de retraits de permis et d'avertissements liés au permis de conduire. Vous pouvez vous le procurer auprès du Service des automobiles de votre région.\* jpid3bc285ajm jpit1146jm jpiy26jm

title: Produktionsleiter*in Landwirtschaft 80-100%
description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Produktionsleiter*in Landwirtschaft 80-100%--- Produktionsleiter\*in Landwirtschaft 80\-100%=============================================Hier wird produziert! Auf dem Spargelhof werden Kürbisse, Spargeln, Erdbeeren und weitere 5 Nebenkulturen produziert. Wir verfolgen hierbei den Weg der regenerativen Landwirtschaft. Hast du Lust, mit uns die Erfolgsgeschichte des Spargelhof Rafz weiterzuschreiben? Dann werde Teil unseres Teams! Unsere landwirtschaftliche Produktionsteam besteht aus 30\-80 Personen, je nach Saison. Ein grosser Teil der Belegschaft sind Saisonkräfte, überwiegend aus Polen, Rumänien und Ungarn. In der Führung dieser Abteilung suchen wir deshalb eine\*n Produktionsleiter\*in.  **Du möchtest wissen, wie wir auf dem Spargelhof Rafz Landwirtschaft arbeiten und wohin wir uns entwickeln? Dann wirf einen Blick hinter die Kulissen und erfahre im**  **mehr über die spannende als Produktionsleiter\*in Landwirtschaft.**Was dich erwartet-----------------Als Produktionsleiter\*in übernimmst du gemeinsam mit dem Führungsteam der Produktion die operative Leitung unserer landwirtschaftlichen Produktion, von der Saisonplanung bis zur Umsetzung auf dem Feld. Dein Fokus wird auf den Bereichen Gemüse \& Ackerkulturen, von Saatgut, Düngung und Pflanzenschutz über Fruchtfolge, Anbaustrategie, Bewässerung und Ernte bis hin zum Betriebsmitteleinkauf liegen. Du planst den Personaleinsatz, führst das Team direkt im Feld und sorgst für effiziente Abläufe. Gleichzeitig entwickelst du unsere Produktion mit Blick auf regenerative Landwirtschaft, Wirtschaftlichkeit und laufende Effizienzsteigerung weiter. Ein besonderer Fokus liegt auf unseren Hauptkulturen Kürbis und Spargel. Gemeinsam mit den Verantwortlichen im Produktionsteam und der Hofleitung entwickelst du diese Kulturen laufend weiter. Die Evaluation neuer Sorten, die Optimierung der Anbaumethoden sowie die Weiterentwicklung von Mechanisierung und Lagerung bilden dabei zentrale Eckpfeiler.Was du mitbringst-----------------Du hast eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Gemüsegärtner\*in EFZ oder eine vergleichbare landwirtschaftliche Ausbildung, beispielsweise als Landwirt\*in EFZ, und bringst bereits Erfahrung in der landwirtschaftlichen Produktion mit. Kenntnisse im Gemüsebau, insbesondere im Anbau von Kürbis oder Spargel, sind von Vorteil. Du hast Freude daran, Menschen zu führen, zu fördern und zu motivieren und bist mit der Führung von Mitarbeitenden aus unterschiedlichen kulturellen Hintergründen vertraut. Organisationstalent, Kommunikationsstärke und unternehmerisches Denken zeichnen dich aus. Du hast Lust, Prozesse laufend zu verbessern, Daten zu analysieren und moderne Arbeitsmethoden einzubringen. Deine Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sind sehr gut, weitere Sprachen von Vorteil, aber kein Muss. Du kannst mit anpacken und bist während den Saisonspitzen belastbar.Was du erwarten kannst----------------------Bei uns kannst du Verantwortung übernehmen, dich weiterentwickeln, eine bodenständige Unternehmenskultur mit echtem Teamgeist erleben. Du wirst gefordert und gefördert, darfst dich aktiv in die Unternehmensentwicklung einbringen. Wir bieten attraktive Anstellungsbedingungen mit diversen Benefits. Darüber hinaus findest du bei der Farm AG einen Arbeitgeber, bei der Nachhaltigkeit zur Unternehmens DNA gehört.![ Farm AG]()* Farm AG  Dorfstrasse 23  8607 Aathal\-Seegräben*jid5a9d0b3jm jit1146jm jiy26jm

title: RF & Photonics Packaging Engineer 100%
description: Are you passionate about pushing the boundaries of photonic integrated circuit (PIC) technology? Lightium, a leading-edge photonics foundry, is looking for an experienced Packaging Engineer to spearhead its RF and optical packaging activities and be the point of contact and manage the relationships with Lightium Packaging Partners. This role offers a unique opportunity to contribute to the next generation of photonics packaging solutions for Lightium’s proprietary high-speed TFLN technology by defining novel assembly concepts, identifying external supplier and packaging houses and define the assembly flow together with internal and external stakeholders. Position Summary As an RF & Photonics Packaging Engineer, you will be responsible for developing Lightium’s Packaging technologies, chip assemblies, as well as supply chain management. You will have the opportunity to leverage your theoretical knowledge and your prior experience in the field of RF and photonics packaging by managing Lightium’s packaging activities and to interface to Lightium’s internal and external customers. You will be responsible for ensuring Lightium’s TFLN chips can be packaged according to our customer’s specification and will drive the implementation of novel packaging concepts with Lightium’s suppliers. You will have the opportunity to work on cutting-edge packaging technologies, such as flip chip bonding, ribbon bonding, microtransfer printing, etc. Key Responsibilities Packaging concepts: You will be actively working with the different internal R&D groups including design, PDK, process development, characterization and test teams to ensure "design for packaging" and "design for testing" is followed in our whole organization. You will identify and implement different packaging concepts compatible with our TFLN technology (e.g., , laser integration, drivers and TIA integration, wire bonding, fiber attachment, etc.) while meeting our customer’s needs. You’ll actively work on ultra-high-speed RF package solutions and simulate the relevant packaging concepts in state-of-the-art electromagnetic simulation tools (such as COMSOL, HFSS, ADS, etc). You’ll also work on fiber-to-chip coupling solutions, spot size converters, and attachment of fiber array units (FAUs).  Supplier identification and management: Lightium and its customers value a multi sourcing strategy. You are responsible that all identified packaging concepts can be sourced from multiple vendors. This includes electrical attach (wire bonding, flip chip bumping and optical fiber and bumping) as well as optical fiber attach. You will drive the diversification of our supply chain including Western, European and Asian suppliers.  Assembly project management: You will drive the day-to-day project management of internal R&D projects, public funded projects and customer assembly projects with external partners, such as assembly houses and OSATs. You will be the point of contact and managing the relationship with packaging houses and OSTAs. You will drive the day-to-day meetings and provide regular updates to Lightum's management. You will define the packaging specs, budget, and timeline for the subcontractors. You will make sure that the assemblies are delivered on time, in spec and in budget to our customers while matching our demanding RF and optical requirements. You will coordinate with Lightium’s R&D team for any package-level testing, characterization, and qualification. Customer engagement: Based on customer requirements, you will identify and implement the matching assembly technologies and concepts. You will track the requirements with a keen eye to detail and make sure all specifications are met and traceable. In this role, you will have the unique opportunity to work with leading transceiver manufacturers and OSATs. Reliability and Quality: You will define the qualification plans and qualification procedures for our packaging concepts. You will work with internal and external stakeholders to run the qualifications, such as environmental reliability or electrical stress tests. In the case of RMA events, you will support the team inassembly-related aspects and embrace customer satisfaction. Collaboration: Work closely with the R&D teams from design to optical testing and characterization, contributing to cross-functional projects to advance our packaging platforms. Occasional travel to Lightium’s assembly partners and OSATs. Participating in public funded projects (HorizonEurope, InnoSuisse, European Chips Act etc.) to develop new packaging concepts and hybrid integration solutions. Documentation and Reporting: Maintain thorough documentation and report findings, as well as establishing standard-operating procedures and training new colleagues. Innovation: Stay up to date on the latest advancements in photonics, incorporating new techniques and technologies into our R&D landscape. Identification of packaging IP and contributing to Lightium’s IP portfolio.  What you’ll bring Educational Background: An advanced degree in Electrical Engineer, Physics, Electro-Optical or Wireless Communications, Integrated Photonics, Chemistry, Material Science or a related field. Experience Level: At least 3 years' work experience (post-graduation) in the field of electronics, photonics, electronic packaging, PCB manufacturing, material science or RF design. Track record of moving electro-optical assemblies from concept over prototyping into production.  Technical Skills: Prior experience with photonic packaging concepts, fiber attach, electronic re-distributing layers (RDLs), under-bump metallization (UBM), bumping, copper pillars or anisotropic conductive glue (ACF) is a plus. Experience in the field of RF simulations (COMSOL, Keysight ADS, Ansys, HFSS and CST) is a clear advantage. Experience with intermetallic phases and SEM-EDX is advantageous. Organization & Documentation: Strong organizational skills with excellent project management skills and a keen eye for details. Experience handling and documenting RMA processes, in outward-facing communication with suppliers and subcontractors at international level. Collaboration: Excellent communication skills and the ability to communicate effectively in a multidisciplinary team and with international customers. Cultural awareness and tailoring of communication style to US, European and Asian partners. Experience with vendor and supplier management at an international level. Adaptability: The ability to thrive in a fast-paced startup environment, demonstrating flexibility and resilience in the face of change. Willingness to travel internationally up to 20%. Language Skills: Fluency in English is required; knowledge of German or any Asian language is an advantage.  What We Offer A unique opportunity to lead a cutting-edge manufacturing initiative in the rapidly growing field of photonics. Competitive compensation and benefits package, including employee stock option plan (ESOP), reflective of your experience and expertise. Become a key player in an early-phase startup and be part of a young, motivated, and energetic team. You will have the unique opportunity to create, grow, and develop your professional skills at a fast pace. We'd love to hear from you if you're passionate about building new tech from the ground up and thrive in a collaborative and innovative environment. Lightium is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Radiation Protection Physicist / Engineer
description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Radiation Protection Physicist / Engineer---Radiation Protection Physicist / Engineer=========================================  The Institute PSI is the largest research institute for natural and engineering sciences within Switzerland. We perform cutting\-edge research in the fields of future technologies, energy and climate, health innovation and fundamentals of nature. By performing fundamental and applied research, we work on sustainable solutions for major challenges facing society, science and economy. PSI is committed to the training of future generations. Therefore, about one quarter of our staff are post\-docs, post\-graduates or apprentices. Altogether, PSI employs 2300 people.For the Decommissioning Studies Group within the Department of Radiation Safety and Security we are looking for aRadiation Protection Physicist / Engineer=========================================### Your tasks* Provide radiation protection expertise and technical guidance for projects, with a particular focus on developing the TATTOOS radioisotope\-production facility as part of the PSI's large\-scale project IMPACT* Organize, implement, and evaluate radiation protection measurement campaigns at PSI, mainly within the IMPACT project, including analysis and interpretation of the experimental data* Develop radiation protection concepts and methods for measuring ionizing radiation (e.g., for clearance measurements, decommissioning activities, and the characterization of radioactive materials) and prepare expert reports (if necessary, with the help of simulations) according to the needs of the group and section* Support the planning and implementation of decommissioning activities for former research reactors, including optimizing clearance measurements through automation and software development* Prepare license and release applications for the regulatory authorities* Translate your work into clear technical reports, quality management documents and scientific publications* Share your findings with the scientific community by presenting studies and results at national and international conferences### Your profile* PhD degree in physics or engineering, or master's degree with equivalent research experience* Solid expertise in radiation physics, protection, and measurement technology. Practical experience with measurement campaigns and experiments at particle accelerators and/or radioisotope\-production facilities is a plus. Experience with methods and technologies for the decommissioning of nuclear installations is also an asset* Excellent command of English (both spoken and written) and proficiency in . Alternatively, a strong commitment to learning quickly* Strong skills in data analysis, data visualization and programming (e.g., C\+\+, )* Knowledge of one or more major radiation transport codes (FLUKA, Geant4, MCNP)### We offerOur institution is based on an interdisciplinary, innovative and dynamic collaboration. You will profit from a systematic training on the job, in addition to personal development possibilities and our pronounced vocational training culture. If you wish to optimally combine work and family life or other personal interests, we are able to support you with our modern employment conditions and the on\-site infrastructure.This is a fixed\-term project position. The employment contract is limited to three years.For further information, please contact Dr. Bolzonella, phone .Please submit your application online by **4\. January 2027** for the position as a Radiation Protection Physicist / Engineer (index no. 9624\-30258\).Institute, People \& Culture, Simen, 5232 Villigen PSI, Switzerland                ![ Institut (PSI)]()*** ![ Institut (PSI)]()***jidc92bdeejm jit1146jm jiy26jm

title: Linux System Engineer
description: EinleitungstextAre you ready to take ownership of world-class Linux infrastructure in a dynamic biological research environment? At the Department of Biosystems Science and Engineering (D-BSSE) of ETH Zurich in Basel, data-driven science meets cutting-edge engineering.As the senior technical anchor for our Linux ecosystem, you will join a focused, close-knit infrastructure group of four. Linux and storage service delivery is shared across three team members (with our fourth colleague focusing on Windows and virtualization). In this position, you will lead the core technical architecture and operations, while two team members work somewhat more closely with daily client and customer support. Underpinning our local setup are the central services of ETH ID, providing robust networking, central storage, and a growing central Linux core.Whether you are already an experienced senior engineer or a talented, motivated Linux professional ready to step into a larger role and expand your capabilities, we offer the autonomy and support for you to thrive. If you want your engineering expertise to directly empower groundbreaking scientific progress, this is your place to grow!Aufgaben-/StellenbeschreibungLead Linux Infrastructure & Services: Take personal responsibility for the technical architecture, continuous development, and 3rd-level operations of our Linux ecosystem, including hosts, web/application platforms (e.g., LAMP), containerization, and Slurm workload management.Automate & Orchestrate Systems: Proactively design, deploy, and refine scalable configuration management tools (Ansible/Puppet), database hosts, and automation scripts to ensure high service availability and operational integrity.Manage Enterprise Storage & High-Performance Data: Provide and maintain robust UNIX/Linux storage (NFS, CIFS, Kerberos, CEPH, RAID). Lead technical investigations into complex data challenges, optimize storage migrations, and safeguard data resilience.Secure Network & System Topologies: Own system security, disaster recovery protocols, and server/service lifecycle management. Define and enforce secure firewall rules, network configurations, and data integrity safeguards.Drive Strategic & Central Projects: Lead our local IT projects with high visibility and dependencies on central IT units, serving as the core technical liaison to deliver modern infrastructure solutions.Consult & Support Scientific Users: Act as an expert partner for internal research groups—advising on client/server specifications, delivering custom infrastructure solutions, and providing support for Linux workstations and servers.Foster Collaboration & Redundancy: Nurture team well-being and operational continuity by mentoring peers, building technical supporting skills redundancy.Ihr ProfilExpertise meets team spirit.You enjoy working as part of a team and value a service-oriented approach to your work. You are able to maintain a clear overview of complex issues and find it easy to get to grips with new technologies and customer needs. You have the following skills or similar:Professional Experience: A few years of hands-on Linux experience with strong foundational knowledge of Ubuntu and RedHat distributions, automation (Ansible and/or Puppet) and scripting, securing, and user-facing environments. Slurm experience is an advantage.Storage & Systems Expertise: Technical familiarity with Unix-related storage technologies (NFS, CIFS, Kerberos, CEPH, RAID), systems monitoring, and server hardware support.Virtualization & Services: Working experience with virtualization, container technologies, and web/application server security.Certifications & Growth: LPIC or Red Hat certification is preferred. We value continuous professional development and support your growth into the broader requirements of the position.Analytical & Methodological Mindset: Strong problem-solving skills, analytical thinking, and a structured, proactive approach to system administration and planning, combined with a sense of innovation.Communication & Inclusivity: Excellent customer orientation, strong communication skills (in English, German an advantage) and an inclusive mindset for collaborating effectively within a diverse, multi-cultural academic environment.Wir bietenPosition-Specific Highlights:A role designed for professional growth, offering high personal autonomy and technical decision-making space.3rd-level systems engineering embedded within the cutting-edge D-BSSE scientific community in Basel.Strong team support with shared operational duties and opportunity to continuously develop your technical skills in a production environment.Comprehensive Benefits Package:Excellent financial security with attractive pension plans via PUBLICA.Public transport subsidies (SBB) and car-sharing options (Mobility).We live: Lifelong learningSee further here.Neugierig? Questions regarding the position should be directed to Vernon Bailey, Head of IT Support vernon.bailey@bsse.ethz.ch (no application documents).Please note that we exclusively accept applications submitted through our online application portal. Applications via email or postal services will not be considered.We would like to point out that the pre-selection is carried out by the responsible recruiters and not by artificial intelligence.

title: Research Scientist in Scientific AI and Geotechnical Engineering
description: EinleitungstextThe Chair of Geotechnical Engineering at ETH Zurich, part of the Institute for Geotechnical Engineering (IGT), focuses its teaching and research on foundation engineering, soil mechanics and natural hazards. Our objective is to combine theoretical knowledge with experiments and numerical simulations to develop new methods for understanding and predicting the behaviour of soils, foundations and infrastructure. We are opening a position in our research group at ETH Zurich, focusing on developing and integrating modern Artificial Intelligence (AI) methods into geotechnical engineering research, while maintaining a strong connection to the underlying physics and mechanics. We do not aim to develop a new AI model or replace physics-based engineering with purely data-driven AI. Instead, we want to use AI to transform the way research itself is performed—from numerical model generation and experimental data acquisition to analysis, visualization and communication.For this purpose, we are looking for a Research Scientist in Scientific AI and Geotechnical Engineering, who will work across the research group, collaborating with PhD students, postdoctoral researchers and senior scientists.The role combines scientific research, computational engineering, research automation, data science and the development of reusable AI-enabled tools. A central objective is to identify new opportunities where AI can enable research that would otherwise be difficult or impossible, and to develop capabilities that can be used across the entire group.Aufgaben-/StellenbeschreibungThe job will interconnect several different areas of our activity:Scientific AI and physics-informed modellingDevelop and apply AI and machine-learning approaches to challenging problems in geotechnical engineering and computational mechanics, with particular emphasis on approaches that combine data with physical knowledge, rather than relying exclusively on black-box, data-driven models.Explore topics including physics-informed and physics-guided machine learning, hybrid physics–ML constitutive modelling, surrogate and reduced-order models, inverse problems and parameter identification, uncertainty quantification, and AI-assisted scientific discovery.Apply these methods to problems involving soil behaviour, soil–structure interaction, liquefaction, natural hazards, foundations and infrastructure resilience.AI-enabled numerical modellingDevelop tools for automating and accelerating numerical modelling workflows, including finite element (FE) and potentially discrete element (DEM) and material point method (MPM) simulations.Automate tasks, such as model generation, geometry and mesh creation, assignment of materials and boundary conditions, parameter studies, high-performance computing (HPC) execution, model verification, extraction of results and standardised post-processing.Create robust and reusable tools that enable researchers throughout the group to build and analyse numerical models more efficiently while retaining appropriate engineering control and verification.Automation of experimental researchDevelop AI-enabled methods for the acquisition, processing and interpretation of experimental data from laboratory and centrifuge testing.Automate sensor-data processing, synchronization of different measurement systems, computer-vision analysis of experiments, extraction of deformation and failure mechanisms from images and videos, identification of experimental parameters, and integration of experimental and numerical results.Geotechnical data intelligenceDevelop methods to exploit the growing volume of geotechnical data available within the group and through external repositories.Organize and extract information from historical laboratory and centrifuge experiments and numerical analyses, and exploit large external datasets and research repositories such as DesignSafe and databases containing geotechnical and geological properties.Contribute to the longer-term development of structured, physics-aware geotechnical datasets to support parameter inference, model calibration, uncertainty quantification, identification of model deficiencies and the development of new physics-informed AI approaches.Scientific visualisation and communicationDevelop automated approaches for transforming research results into high-quality visualisations, animations and videos.Develop tools that support scientific publications and presentations while facilitating effective communication of research through websites, teaching materials, professional audiences and social-media platforms.Group-wide AI capabilityHelp establish AI as a broadly accessible research capability within the group.Identify opportunities for AI across ongoing research activities, develop common tools and workflows, provide internal training and documentation, and work directly with researchers to enable them to use modern AI and computational methods effectively and independently.Ihr ProfilWe are looking for an intellectually curious scientist / engineer who combines strong computational skills with an interest in physical systems and engineering research. A background in geotechnical engineering is not mandatory but can represent an advantage.PhD in computational mechanics, computational engineering, scientific machine learning, applied mathematics, computer science, civil or mechanical engineering, or a closely related discipline.Excellent programming skills.Strong background in numerical methods, such as FEM, FD, DEM or MPM.Demonstrated experience with machine learning, modern AI methods and AI-assisted software development.Experience with scientific data engineering, databases and the processing of large or heterogeneous datasets.Experience with HPC, parallel computing and/or GPU computing.Experience with automated simulation workflows and APIs.Experience with scientific visualisation and the automated generation of figures, animations or videos.Experience with computer vision and image/video analysis is particularly valuable.Candidates from other fields than geotechnical engineering with strong expertise in computational mechanics and Scientific AI are strongly encouraged to apply. The successful candidate will work closely with experienced geotechnical researchers who will provide the necessary domain expertise.Beyond specific technical qualifications, we are particularly interested in candidates who can bridge disciplines. The successful candidate should be able to understand an engineering or scientific problem, identify where AI or computational methods can provide genuine added value, develop a rigorous solution, and transform that solution into a reusable capability for other researchers.We therefore value scientific creativity, strong software-development practices, independence, collaborative ability and an enthusiasm for learning new areas.The position is particularly suited to someone who is excited by the opportunity to help shape a new research direction at the intersection of Artificial Intelligence, mechanics, experimentation and geotechnical engineering.Wir bietenThe opportunity to help shape a new research direction at the intersection of Artificial Intelligence, computational mechanics, experimentation and geotechnical engineering.Considerable freedom to identify research opportunities and contribute to the development of new methods as AI technologies and Scientific AI continue to evolve.The opportunity to work across scientific research, computational engineering, numerical simulations, experimental research and data science.Close collaboration with PhD students, postdoctoral researchers and senior scientists in an interdisciplinary research environment.The opportunity to develop reusable AI-enabled tools and workflows that strengthen research capabilities across the group.Neugierig? Sind wir auch.We look forward to receiving your online application with the following documents:CVMotivation letterDiplomaReference LettersFurther information about the Chair of Geotechnical Engineering can be found on our website. Questions regarding the position should be directed to Dr. Alexandru Marin, Tel. +41 44 633 7370 or alexandru.marin@igt.baug.ethz.ch (no applications).Please note that we exclusively accept applications submitted through our online application portal. Applications via email or postal services will not be considered.We would like to point out that the pre-selection is carried out by the responsible recruiters and not by artificial intelligence.
